summary: EVAVO's deterministic engine, visual authoring environment and production toolchain for original authentic 1990s-style point-and-click adventure games. Adventure Studio owns profile-driven classic-adventure presentation, canonical project/runtime schemas, scene staging, interaction/dialogue/inventory/puzzles/scoring/cutscenes, deterministic play feel/audio/saves/replays, progression integrity, visual production tooling and reproducible browser/Windows exports while upstream specialist assets and broader portfolio/game-design governance remain separate authorities.

capabilities.title: Compile deterministic adventure projects
capabilities.description: Validate human-readable project schemas and migrations and compile stable source projects into deterministic runtime bundles with reproducible identities and replaceable editor/renderer/platform clients.

capabilities.title: Direct classic-adventure production profiles
capabilities.description: Apply original production families that bind canvas, palette, scene grammar, actor performance, interface, puzzle, audio, splash and showcase direction, with reference-fidelity packs used as evidence rather than copied commercial content.

capabilities.title: Author native adventure scenes and staging
capabilities.description: Author rooms in one native coordinate truth with walk/control/depth/occlusion/hotspot/approach/actor/surface/light/entry data, footprint clearance, preferred lanes, perspective, entry choreography and multi-plane foreground priority.

capabilities.title: Run classic adventure interaction systems
capabilities.description: Execute deterministic navigation, verbs/context cursors, inventory, dialogue, conditions, flags, scoring, object interactions, cutscenes and scene transitions across supported parser/icon/verb/coin/two-button/context interaction models.

capabilities.title: Explore progression and detect recoverability risks
capabilities.description: Run bounded canonical-state exploration through object interactions, inventory, dialogue and sequence outcomes to prove routes, expose unreachable objectives and identify soft-lock/recoverability risks.

capabilities.title: Simulate deterministic classic-adventure play feel
capabilities.description: Apply authored acceleration, braking, cornering, footfall phase, camera response, command buffering and fixed-step frame pacing so play feel is profile-specific and independent of display cadence.

capabilities.title: Bind deterministic adventure audio production
capabilities.description: Coordinate authored buses, voice limits, cue loop points, fades, ducking, room soundscapes, cinematic cues, speech bindings and performance markers against the fixed-tick runtime/save contract while Audio Studio remains upstream audio production authority.

capabilities.title: Produce deterministic saves and replays
capabilities.description: Persist and restore deterministic adventure state and record/export replay commands so debugging, playtesting and regression analysis can reproduce exact progression behavior.

capabilities.title: Use the visual adventure production studio
capabilities.description: Author/review scene composition, Scene Director overlays, geometry, objects, animation, art direction, bitmap fonts, localization, interface skins, audio, dialogue, timelines, playtest artifacts and validation through the shared canonical project.

capabilities.title: Run Adventure Studio authenticity and runtime validation
capabilities.description: Validate project contracts, native dimensions, indexed pixels, binary alpha, bitmap fonts, interface geometry, staging, progression, replays and compiled exports without treating technical validity as creative approval or game release.

topics: adventure interaction dialogue inventory and puzzles
